detail.longDescription: So, I have a SQS queue, and I was wondering that whether having 2 DLQs is a good practice for my project. The 1st DLQ will be used in case of invalid body or discrepancy in JSON and 2nd DLQ will be used in case when the message is retried for max number of times. Is this a good practice or only 1 DLQ should be used for all?
